title: Introduce SinkPlay RAG Labshell quickstart and deterministic sink adapter
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a compact interactive quickstart called 'SinkPlay' that demonstrates a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) journey with a deterministic sink adapter and an embeddable local labshell runner. Motivation: give engineers a repeatable on-ramp for instrumenting tool-calling, failure-injection, and local structured-output debugging workflows without needing remote indexers or external services. Key deliverables: 1) quickstart package under quickstarts/sinkplay with a step-by-step codelab and preseeded mini-index, 2) labshell static runner (browser+worker) that can run the scenario locally, 3) deterministic sink adapter for instrumenting tool responses and failure modes, 4) CI smoke tests (GitHub Actions) that run the labshell headless scenario and validate structured output contracts, and 5) docs site snippets and a compact troubleshooting guide. Checklist: - [x] Add codelab markdown and step artifacts - quickstarts/sinkplay/README.md - [x] Include TypeScript adapter and Python shim for tool stubs - quickstarts/sinkplay/adapters/ - [x] Add labshell runner and headless integration test - .github/workflows/sinkplay-smoke.yml - [x] Add docsite snippet and recipe to docs/quickstarts.json - [x] Wire up telemetry probes and assertion hooks for evals This PR references ENG-4892 for the telemetry probes and PM-183 for the workshop agenda. How to try locally: 1) git checkout feature/sinkplay-labshell-quickstart 2) cd quickstarts/sinkplay 3) npm install && npm run dev to open the labshell at http://localhost:3000 4) follow the guided steps in README.md to seed the mini-index, run a RAG conversation, trigger deterministic sink failure, and inspect structured-output assertions. CI: added a headless runner job that launches the labshell in Playwright, fires the scripted RAG sequence, and verifies the output contract and telemetry events. Security: the quickstart runs locally and does not ship secrets; the CI job uses ephemeral tokens scoped to sandbox resources. Release notes: Adds a developer-facing interactive RAG quickstart (SinkPlay) to streamline learning and testing of tool calling and failure handling patterns.
